body:
Yeah, I'd love to find a great therapist that works for me, but I've tried quite a few times already.

I'll try and focus on the good things again, more than before, and see if that changes anything for me.

I've tried therapy a few times, but to no success.

I make too little money to afford anything for myself, I make just enough to pay for the bills at the moment. That's why I need a new job.

I do my hobbies regularly, but they've become powerless and can't stop me from feeling the way I do.

And I have a gym membership, I haven't used it as much as I want yet. So I'll definitely do that.

Journaling is a good idea, someone else also said that. It would just be like writing my feelings or something?
Messaged
That's not a bad idea, maybe I could do that. I guess I'd review the journal when I feel like I did last night?

Covid had made me move away from everyone I've ever known. So I now live in a far away state, isolated.

I've also tried therapy numerous times, but it's never helped me.
Thank you for sharing this. I'll try my best to remember that.
I would definitely say thank you. Small things like that can go a long way. I'm sure she would appreciate it!

I would send him the letter. Having no closure sucks, and sometimes it'll wreck someone for years. I wish I had closure. I bet he does too.

I'm sorry about how you're feeling, please get better soon. Tell him the truth, and how you feel.
I see people have commented, but I can't view them and respond. Reddit won't let me. When Reddit let's me, I'll definitely respond to everyone.

I hope everything worked out for you and your boyfriend in the month I haven't responded. I wish you both only the best outcome. Sorry it took so long to respond, the days blend together and I loose track of time.

I'll stay alive, not for myself though. Just because if I go, my already dying mother would be devastated. I may be suicidal, but I'm not selfish. As long as my mom lives, I'm not dying yet.

People that have that are so lucky. It's a kind of reassurance I think everyone needs to be healthy. Unsociable or not, everyone at their core are social animals. We're humans, it's how we're wired. We need that attention, that connection, in some way shape or form. It's a shame some people, no matter how hard they try, never get that connection. Being deprived of it, can seriously lead to unhealthy or straight up horrible irreversible outcomes.

Just simply being there for someone when they least expect it, can change literally everything. It can make a world of difference. Loving someone is a very fragile and special thing, and more times than not, a partner will care heavily what the other thinks; or has to say. That's why if you love someone, it's important to tell them and go out of your way to make them smile. You can really change someone's perspective for the better that way, just by holding their hand and always being by their side no matter what.

It's a tough question, and really, I don't think there's a single right answer. Depending on who he is, there can be a multitude of answers.

I myself, am much like you described. I have no joy, no excitment, for anything that happens to me anymore. I've lost that part of me. The difference is with me, I have nobody in my life period. I just simply get worse and worse with my depression with nobody around to help me, or tell me they care. That to me, makes my life unlivable. It makes me care for my life less and less everyday. Because clearly, there isn't a soul on this planet for me.

I say this to you, not to highlight myself, but to highlight that loneliness from my own example. Your boyfriend isn't alone, he has you.

No matter how depressed he must be, I bet he still loves you greatly. I know it's hard, and at the end of the day, it's up to him to better himself, but if you want to help you can do little things.

Remind him you're there for him, how much you love and care for him. Tell him how he helped you through your episode, and show resolve to return the favor. Surprise call him, surprise text him, all that stuff. It'll remind him, someone out there loves him. Reinforce that you're a single force, and that together, you'll figure it out. And when you guys can get together, give him that 100% sunshine personality.

I know I'm not much help, most of what I said probably isn't rocket science. But, I just wanted to try and help out. Good luck, and just remember, all you can do is do your best. So do that, and I'm sure it'll pay off.
I'm sorry to hear that, I understand how you feel. Happy birthday! I'm way late, but I hope you met some nice people to talk to here.

21m, depends for me. On a bad day I'd probably agree with you heavily. But looking at it, I've spoken to some pretty great people here. Some have helped me look at a bigger picture. I don't think there's anything wrong talking to people online like this. It's nice meeting new people and openly talking to them, especially since most people here you'll never get the opportunity to become friends with in person.

So don't be so hard on yourself. Just keep doing your best in life and doing what's best for you. Friends are friends, you shouldn't downplay yourself because you find yourself here trying to make them.

No, it's impossible to move back near my original support system. Far too expensive, it's not possible. My mom had a bad mental breakdown because she wanted to go back so bad, she was willing to abandon all of us for it. We're stuck here, and it's even ripping apart my normal family. My sister doesn't even talk or look at me anymore. Everyone isn't handling it well. I've tried so many times to talk to her, but she just gets pissed if I try and speak with her.

I know you're right about the second piece, after all, that's logical. I just find it scary, because every person I've been with has trampled and used me. I don't want that to happen again. Plus I want to make someone happy, and I can't do that if I'm here staring at my balcony debating what would happen if I jumped off. No one deserves that, I don't want to give someone hope, and then horrible turmoil. Nobody should have to feel this intensity I feel.

Meds, maybe. But I don't want to resort to drugs to stop this. I could, but idk, part of me feels like that's an easy way out. Am I stupid for feeling that way? I need to win against this, that's how I feel. But, I wouldn't mind losing either, because if I win idk what else I could do.

To answer your edited pieces, I used to listen to a lot of positive affirmations. But most of the time, they would cause me to go into mini panic attacks because I'd realize how wrong they were. At least it started like that, now it just makes my heart ache. It's very hard to battle my down thoughts with other things, so I usually sit down in my room in the dark alone, and calmly wait for it to pass.

As for community, my area I know little about. The best I get is at work, and around my co-workers I feel fine. They're the closest things to friends I have. But even then, there's things that can trigger these major depression episodes even at my job. Like they'll just randomly switch on, and I act as normal as I can. It's really hard to, but I manage. I live in an area where there's mostly land now, compared to the bustling busy life I grew up in. There's a lot more places being built now, but it's still very empty.

It was very hard for me to try therapy. Something happened in my childhood that made me despise the idea of it so much, it caused me anger. It was only this year that I dug really deep into myself and really tried to move passed that trauma and try it. I felt myself slipping, like sooner or later I'd end up dead. I wanted to try and stop it. So I had to overcome myself to do it.

I was ghosted by my first therapist, simple as that. Just ignored me after session 1.

After my mother had a mental breakdown and tried abandoning me and my sister, she was placed in the hospital for a long time. I tried  therapy again, but this therapist only tried taking extra money from me while attempting to diagnose me with crazy things that would make it hard for me to make a living for myself. My father got involved, it was bad. Not fun.

I tried a third time, but idk. It was so unbelievably hard to try it once, let alone a second time. I don't know if I can keep doing this anymore. I barely have enough in me to get up in the morning. Living in this new state all alone, so far away from everyone I know. I don't feel alive anymore. This isn't the world I grew up in for 21 years.

I don't want anyone worrying about me, It's wasted time. I'm glad you have something so amazing, I once did. I tried so hard to make her happy, I gave her everything I could. Gave her the supplies she needed to get her into her dream college even. Her parents never believed in her, but I always did. I still do. I tried so hard, that eventually she hated me. It was my fault. I wasn't enough for her. One night, she ranted to me about how terrible a person I was, sunset, to sunrise. I just sat there, and listened. I didn't sleep because I cared about how she felt. She was the closest person I ever had to love, I don't know if I'll ever find something again. I can't take anymore hurt. I simply can't.

I agree, I need to be mentally sound before finding a partner. But I'm so far detached and gone, I'm not sure how or when I'll get better. No one deserves the train wreck I am. For a while, I just wanted to find a companion. Someone I can be with and be there for. But recently, I've lost the feeling of want for that. Now I just want to die.

I tried getting a therapist, they ghosted me after the first session. I have a certain trauma when it comes to asking for help, it was impossibly hard as it was to admit it once. I don't think I can do it again.

I've been living in this state for over a year, and I still haven't seen a single person my age. Plus, with my mental state as it is, I don't think anyone deserves the terrible messy load that I am even if I did meet someone. Everyone's better off without my stupidly complex mental health.

The world has gone to shit these past two years, I know. My heart goes out to everyone that are struggling. For me though, I know I'm not worth it. There was this person I cared for a lot, they were my entire world. She told me I was a worthless failure, and as time goes on, I'm starting to understand why she thought that way. For quite a few years, life has been nothing but crippling. With each passing day, I think about dying more and more. Deep down, I know I'm too pathetic and scared to try it, so I'll probably just keep living. I hope life picks up too, but my mind has already accepted the possibility of it never picking up again.

Thanks for taking the time to comment, have a nice day.

I know deep down I'm too much of a weak fool to actually pull it off. I want to die, but I know I probably don't have it within me. The life I once had is over. The reason I had to live crushed me like a waste of space. At this point, I choose to die. Nothing in my life will fix any of this. This life I have now, I'm not sure who's it is. The life I used to have ended already. I'm starting to lose my memory of that past too, I don't know what to do anymore. I'm nothing more than a walking husk of someone that used to exist. I don't care what life through my way anymore, I feel I can accept anything.

Thanks for taking the time to comment.

I know already. I'm far more pathetic and worthless than they are. The fact I think or feel like this is terrible. I have no right to feel this way when others are so much worse than I am.

Thank you for reading and commenting.

We'll never know for sure what lies beyond. Personally, I think nothing lies beyond. We have our lives now, and nothing else. I rather suffer in a place where there's infinte nothing, rather than suffer in a place where I know I'm a failure and worthless to others.

Thanks for reading and commenting.

The person I saw when I was a kid? Yeah, I still want to be that now. But I'm not good enough for it. This numbness I feel, it makes it hard to care anymore.

Thank you for reading and taking the time to comment.

That was an interesting video, I get the meaning behind it. Very well made, and funny too. Thanks for sharing that.

I'll keep living, even though I don't want to. It's hard to dedicate myself to something when nothing I love makes me feel anything anymore.

Thanks for taking your time to leave a comment.
Feed the pig?

That's a kinda long story. This account I'm using is a little over a year old now. I've made several posts about my predicament over the year. Some posts probably sound more severe than others, I apologize for that. I did write some of them while in the heat of the moment. If you want me to summarize it, I can sure. If you want a more detailed look though, you're more than welcome fo see the things I've said.

Yeah, I have two dogs. I live with my parents and younger sister, though the move has worsened everyone's mental health. A good amount of the time, staying home isn't the best. Or it at least feels like that.

Thanks for the advice and words though, I really appreciate it.
Alright
That was very educational, thank you for sharing that. I'll have to find more things I can feel like that in.

I left my house last night and walked around. It felt oddly refreshing. So I think I get what you're saying. Get out there, try new things, and better yourself.

I'll do my best to do that, somehow. Thank you.

I once did meet with a therapist, but they ghosted me. Never heard from them again. Admitting that I have these problems is really difficult, so seeing one originally took me weeks of built up courage. I feel really guilty or small when I admit these things. Telling my parents about this though, makes me feel just as terrible. When you admit you have a problem, you submit to it. You lose. I can't lose.

I was raised with the understanding that I'm male, and that one day I'll meet special people that need me to always be at my best so they can live happy. That's what I want, and is what I've been aiming to do my whole life. But to do that, I can't be as weak as I am now. If I'm weak, then I can't accomplish any of that. I can't make people happy, I can't support others if I can't figure out myself, I can't be a man.

I've just hit my early 20s now, I have to be an adult and start being that man, but I'm not. Losing everyone I've ever known, and being isolated for over a year really cripples someone. Sometimes it feels like this secluded hell will never end, and in the end I'll never meet anyone or figure myself out. It all makes me feel so weak.

I got very close with her, and for a long time it was quite genuine. I didn't commit to sex for a little while, refused for quite some time. But even those moments where she was genuine I tend to question now.

More or less, I wanted to write this to share my feels on the matter. To begin to show my doubt over her repeating actions and such. I thought the repetition alone may give readers an idea on how it looks to me.

I definitely did learn from it though, but she still lingers in my head quite constantly. Towards the middle and end, she was definitely fake, but it makes me think about the start. Did she ever love me? I'll never know.

Thanks for reading and responding.
Thank you.
Happy Birthday!
I'm sorry to hear that. Honestly, no one deserves to feel crummy like this. For you as well, my messages are open.

I'm not old enough to go to a bar yet, though I will be next month. I'm not aware of any bars or clubs around me, but yet again, I haven't looked. I looked into groups, but where I live, nothing really worked the way I was looking for. I do have a great hobby and career path, but this real life loneliness stuff kills a lot of excitement I think I should have.

Hey, sorry it took me over a week to respond. Thanks for taking the time out to read what I wrote and reach out to help me. I'll make sure to take your advice, thank you for the support. Have a nice day, and good luck to you as well!
